title: Open when you're having a bad day
description: For the days when everything feels bad and you just need someone to talk to.
content:
Having a bad day? Aww, that's alright. I'm sorry I couldn't be there to help you out, but at least I can write this.

My dear, you don't have to act strong or fine. You can just be sad today, you're allowed to.

I know you miss your dad a lot, and why wouldn't you? He was the one who didn't let you cook because you might hurt yourself. But don't you think his love still exists through you? You always ask me if I ate and tell me to take care. One way or another it goes through me too. You influenced me, and now it's in me, so I will try my best to love you enough.

And if something is wrong at home, don't worry too much. It will all be fine. But for now you gotta be alright, so you can make everything better. Just know that even if someone is being mean to you today, you can come to me and complain about it. I promise I won't judge you or anyone. I will listen, even if we are mad at each other or not talking or whatever it is that made you open this letter instead of texting me. I promise you I am always available to listen to you, no matter what big mess we are in. I'll be a good listener for as long as you need to complain, or you can just ask me to watch something with you or talk to you. I always love talking to you and spending time with you. Even in an argument, I'm with you. I promise I will always be there for you.

For now, just eat something sweet, maybe ice cream or whatever feels sweet to you, drink some water, and then text or call me anytime.

I love you a lot. Take care of yourself, okay??

— Manji ♡

title: Open when you miss me

content:
Oh really? 🤨

I don't get hiccups though.

title: Open on your birthday
description: For your special day, because you deserve to be celebrated.
content:
Happy birthday, sweetheart!! 🎂

I hope you woke up today and felt how special you are, because you really are. I'm so happy you were born, and I'm so happy I got to know you.

I know this year wasn't easy for you. You went through a lot and you still kept going, and I'm really proud of you for that. But today is your day, so forget everything else for a bit. Just be happy and let people love you.

Eat all the sweets you want today. Wear whatever makes you feel pretty. And please hear from the people who love you, because there are more of us than you think.

I hope this year is gentler to you. I hope your family is kind to you, I hope you get peace of mind, and I hope everything you've been wishing for finally comes true. And I hope someday I get to say happy birthday to you in person.

Also, thank you for being my friend, for listening to me and for caring about me. You mean a lot to me.

I love you a lot, sweetheart. Happy birthday again 🤍

— Manji ♡

title: Open when you're upset with me
description: For when I messed up and I need you to hear that I'm sorry.
content:
Maafi malkin 😭🥹

Pata nahi kya ulta seedha karta rehta hoon, bohot bhondu hoon main. Maaf kar do.

Whatever I said, I must be feeling so stupid. I swear I can't even think of hurting you. Maybe I said something stupid as sarcasm and you didn't understand it, so ask me about it, okay? 🥹 Or maybe I don't know, I'm so sorry, my sweetheart, my honeypie, my moonbeam, my star, my bla bla bla bla bla bla bla.

Just talk to me. I bet I'm more upset than you, I can bet my whole life on it. Sorryyyyy. I will do as you say, just don't be upset with me. I never mean to be mean, because I love you a lot.

— Manji ♡
